text:
Asha: Quick Q from my IC: theyre asking about a possible mid-cycle promotion + comp adj. Whats the recommended path?

Marta (People Ops): Route it through the comp-change form if salary/equity changes are involved. If its title-only, use the title-update flow.

Asha: Link? also any required manager signoffs?

payroll-bot: comp-change form: <https://redwood.internal/hr/comp-change-format> \u00b7 title update: <https://redwood.internal/hr/title-update>

Liam (Comp): Managers should include band, new job family, and calibration notes. If the proposed salary is above band max, you'll need VP People + Finance approval.

Ravi (Eng): For retention counters, can we retroactively make the effective date the start of the month when the offer came in?

Liam (Comp): We avoid backdating unless Finance explicitly approves. Payroll cutoffs matter: submit by the 7th for next-month effective, otherwise next cycle.

Asha: What about spot/one-time retention bonuses instead of salary changes? Easier?

Marta (People Ops): Yes, one-time bonuses are often faster. Use the one-time-payment request form and mark as retention. Finance approval still required but no band exception.

Liam (Comp): Also consider equity refresh if long-term retention is the goal. Those require comp + legal review and follow grant windows (quarterly grant runs).

Ravi (Eng): Any manager guidance on how to explain a denied comp request? Don't want to upset the IC.

Marta (People Ops): Short script: thank them, explain the decision rationale (band limits / budget), offer timeline for re-review, discuss alternative levers (bonus, stretch role, roadmap visibility). See manager playbook: <https://redwood.internal/hr/manager-playbook#difficult-convos>

Asha: What supporting docs speed approvals?

Liam (Comp): Redacted competing offer, market data (three comps), manager bullets on impact, and expected retention risk if not approved.

Ravi (Eng): Is there a calibration meeting requirement for promos mid-cycle?

Liam (Comp): If its above band or high-impact, we ask comp to present at the monthly calibration sync. For normal promos within band, no extra meeting.

Asha: Payroll specifics  any example of the payroll code or json we need to include?

payroll-bot: For payroll, include these fields in the form: employee_id, effective_date (YYYY-MM-DD), comp_element (base|bonus|eq), amount, cost_center. Example CSV row: `12345,2026-04-01,base,125000,ENG-PLATFORM`

Marta (People Ops): If you need a faster turnaround, flag as urgent in the form and add manager rationale; Finance triages urgents but still needs approvals.

Ravi (Eng): Follow-up  can we do a title promotion now and stagger salary to next comp cycle to fit budget?

Liam (Comp): Yes. Mark as "title-only now" and submit a comp-change later. Communicate both dates clearly to the employee.

Asha: Great  thanks. I'll fill out the form and attach the redacted offer + market comps.

Marta (People Ops): Ping me once submitted if you want a quick pre-check.

Ravi (Eng): Thanks, saving this thread for my leads.

Asha: Appreciate it :pray:
